For Parents

Looking for something more meaningful than screen time?

Mindathon is a physical, interactive experience you can share with your children.

Home/For Parents
Screen-free by design

Time together that trains the mind

Mindathon gives children a screen-free activity that's genuinely engaging — challenges that make them think, respond and participate, with you right there playing alongside.

It's not homework in disguise. It feels like a game — because it is one. A game designed by a memory trainer with 33 years of experience.

Screen-free activity

No apps, no autoplay, no notifications — just a game in your hands.

Active participation

Every round needs your child's full attention and response.

Family interaction

Parents and children play together — talking, laughing, thinking.

Cognitive skill practice

Memory, focus, speed and problem solving — practised through play.

What it offers

Challenge, engagement and learning through play

Challenge & engagement

Rounds are short and snappy, so attention stays where it matters.

Learning through play

Skills are practised naturally — children learn without feeling drilled.

Positive family time

Shared challenges create shared wins — a game the whole family can enjoy.

Questions parents ask

Common questions, answered

Is Mindathon suitable for my child?
Mindathon is designed as a learning and engagement game for students and families. For guidance on the most suitable version for your child's age and needs, please contact the Mindathon team.
Can parents play with their children?
Absolutely. Mindathon is designed as a group activity — it's just as enjoyable when parents play alongside their children.
Do we need any special equipment?
No screens or apps are needed. Mindathon is a complete physical game set. Please contact the team for details about what's included.
